trailhead.label: Niederrasen parish church (official start; parking by the church)

waypoints.label: Refill fountain at Niederrasen primary school

cautions: About 3 km on quiet asphalt farm lanes without pavement.
Steep, rough forest track on the climb to Kirmlehof.
Locked forestry barrier near Obergoste (walkers pass).
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
